class InterpolationMissingOptionErrorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """InterpolationMissingOptionError raised through real ConfigParser.get."""

    # -- BasicInterpolation --

    def _basic_parser(self):
        cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.BasicInterpolation())
        cp.add_section('sect')
        cp.set('sect', 'opt', 'value %(missing)s end')
        return cp

    def test_basic_missing_option(self):
        cp = self._basic_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        self.assertIsInstance(
            exc, configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, 'opt')
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, 'sect')
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, 'missing')
        self.assertEqual(
            str(exc),
            "option 'opt' in section 'sect' "
            "references 'missing' which is not a section name")

    def test_basic_raw_true(self):
        cp = self._basic_parser()
        self.assertEqual(
            cp.get('sect', 'opt', raw=True),
            'value %(missing)s end')

    def test_basic_resolved_after_set(self):
        cp = self._basic_parser()
        cp.set('sect', 'missing', 'X')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('sect', 'opt'), 'value X end')

    def test_basic_shallow_copy(self):
        cp = self._basic_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        exc2 = copy.copy(exc)
        self.assertEqual(exc2.option, 'opt')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.section, 'sect')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.reference, 'missing')
        self.assertEqual(str(exc2), str(exc))

    def test_basic_deep_copy(self):
        cp = self._basic_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        exc2 = copy.deepcopy(exc)
        self.assertEqual(exc2.option, 'opt')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.section, 'sect')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.reference, 'missing')
        self.assertEqual(str(exc2), str(exc))

    def test_basic_pickle(self):
        cp = self._basic_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
            with self.subTest(protocol=proto):
                buf = pickle.dumps(exc, protocol=proto)
                exc2 = pickle.loads(buf)
                self.assertEqual(exc2.option, 'opt')
                self.assertEqual(exc2.section, 'sect')
                self.assertEqual(exc2.reference, 'missing')
                self.assertEqual(str(exc2), str(exc))

    # -- ExtendedInterpolation --

    def _extended_parser(self):
        cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cp.add_section('sect')
        cp.set('sect', 'opt', 'value ${missing} end')
        return cp

    def test_extended_missing_option(self):
        cp = self._extended_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        self.assertIsInstance(
            exc, configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, 'opt')
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, 'sect')
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, 'missing')

    def test_extended_cross_section_missing(self):
        cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cp.add_section('main')
        cp.add_section('other')
        cp.set('main', 'opt', 'val ${other:nope} end')
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('main', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        self.assertIsInstance(
            exc, configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, 'opt')
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, 'main')
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, 'nope')

    def test_extended_raw_true(self):
        cp = self._extended_parser()
        self.assertEqual(
            cp.get('sect', 'opt', raw=True),
            'value ${missing} end')

    def test_extended_resolved_after_set(self):
        cp = self._extended_parser()
        cp.set('sect', 'missing', 'X')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('sect', 'opt'), 'value X end')

    def test_extended_cross_section_resolved(self):
        cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cp.add_section('main')
        cp.add_section('other')
        cp.set('main', 'opt', 'val ${other:nope} end')
        cp.set('other', 'nope', 'Y')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('main', 'opt'), 'val Y end')

    def test_extended_shallow_copy(self):
        cp = self._extended_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        exc2 = copy.copy(exc)
        self.assertEqual(exc2.option, 'opt')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.section, 'sect')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.reference, 'missing')

    def test_extended_deep_copy(self):
        cp = self._extended_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        exc2 = copy.deepcopy(exc)
        self.assertEqual(exc2.option, 'opt')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.section, 'sect')
        self.assertEqual(exc2.reference, 'missing')

    def test_extended_pickle(self):
        cp = self._extended_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cm:
            cp.get('sect', 'opt')
        exc = cm.exception
        for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
            with self.subTest(protocol=proto):
                buf = pickle.dumps(exc, protocol=proto)
                exc2 = pickle.loads(buf)
                self.assertEqual(exc2.option, 'opt')
                self.assertEqual(exc2.section, 'sect')
                self.assertEqual(exc2.reference, 'missing')
